m.q: A circuit is Q=(A AND B) OR C. Find X=A AND B and Q for inputs (1,0,1) and (1,1,0). [4 marks]
st: Work from the AND gate, X=A AND B, then OR X with C.

w: For Q=(A AND B) OR C, evaluate inputs 0,1,0 and 1,1,1. Show X and Q. [4 marks]
A different system uses Q=NOT A OR B. Find Q when inputs are 1,0 and 0,0. [4 marks]
For 1,0, NOT A=0 [1] so Q=0 [1]. For 0,0, NOT A=1 [1] so Q=1 [1].
Explain why Q=(A AND B) OR C is always 1 when C=1. [4 marks]
X=A AND B can be 0 or 1 [1]. OR combines X with C [1]. With C=1, at least one OR input is 1 [1], so Q=1 [1].

k.q: Trace the combined alarm calculation and predict the final output.
k.code:
A = 1
B = 0
C = 1
X = (A == 1 AND B == 1)
Q = (X OR C == 1)
if Q then
    print("Alarm")
else
    print("Quiet")
endif
p: Set C=0, leaving A=1 and B=0.
k.a: Initially X=false and Q=true, so Alarm. With C=0, Q=false and Quiet prints. With A=1,B=1,C=0, X=true and Alarm prints.
